changes.summary: Added ModerationUnavailableError class, timeout support, test mock hooks, and strict fail-closed exception throwing instead of silent compliant bypass.
Wrapped moderateContent in check-content route with try-catch returning HTTP 503 MODERATION_UNAVAILABLE on ModerationUnavailableError.
Added comprehensive DEF-004 test suite verifying 7 distinct test cases for compliant, prohibited, unavailable, timeout, no-false-accusation, and publication safety.
